purpose: Append-only notebook for the COW synthesis loop. The loop runs unattended, so anything a human would want to know afterwards goes here instead of stopping the run: fidelity judgements worth a second opinion, tool flags the writer overrode, defects found in the source, and chapters the driver rejected.
how: Never hand-edit. Append with: python3 scripts/synthesis-note.py --book <book> --chapter <ch> --kind <kind> --note '<text>' [--verses 3,7]. Review with: python3 scripts/synthesis-note.py --list [--kind ...] [--since YYYY-MM-DD].

kinds.fidelity: why a verse was graded B, or an A that felt borderline
kinds.disagreement: a STRETCH / ENTITIES / UNSOURCED flag the writer judged a false positive, and why
kinds.source-defect: scrape residue, a misplaced witness block, an out-of-range verse key
kinds.rejected: written by the driver when a chapter fails verification and is reverted
kinds.observation: anything else the next reader should know

entries.note: Graded B: each leans on a Keil and Delitzsch or Matthew Henry block filed under a different verse key (K&D vv.10-13 resumption, Henry v9 on Mahanaim, K&D v37 distributive gloss). Faithful to the chapter's catena, not to the verse's own slot.

Every Jamieson, Fausset and Brown block in this chapter is scrape residue from elsewhere: Deuteronomy on lending, Exodus on the Hebrew servant, and repeated Passover/feast material. All omitted silently; JFB is named nowhere in the chapter.

Ellicott appears nowhere in this chapter's catena or corpora, yet the OLD prose named him on all 45 verses. This is the documented Joshua fabrication from the 2026-08-09 audit. Dropped entirely rather than re-grounded.
ENTITIES flags for Chronicler, Maccabean, Zebulunite judged false positives: my own descriptive nouns, and Maccabean is grounded since K&D cite 1 Macc 5:26 on Busra.
Expansion of 3x-8x on the thin verses is inherent to the thin exemption, which pairs a 20-30 word catena with a 120-word floor. Not evidence of invention.

First draft introduced facts absent from this catena: Deborah and Elijah at the Kishon, Jacob naming Mahanaim, Moses sending from the wilderness of Kedemoth, and a Numbers 35:6 citation. All removed before commit rather than recorded as B; an unsupported claim is a rewrite, not a note.
